category_title: At-risk four-year-olds from low-income families with context-dependent oral language proficiency
scenario_title: Adult interaction during non-teaching directed center time
minimal_context: The student is playing in the block center during non-teaching directed time to develop communication skills with peers and adults.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are you doing with those blocks?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am going to build a castle in the block center.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Give some of those blocks to your friend.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (To peer) If you don’t give me that toy, you’ll be sorry!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Listen to me and follow directions.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: What are you doing with those blocks?

STUDENT: I am going to build a castle in the block center.

TUTOR: Give some of those blocks to your friend.

STUDENT: (To peer) If you don’t give me that toy, you’ll be sorry!

TUTOR: Listen to me and follow directions.

STUDENT: No.

task.content: Communicating with adults and peers during non-teaching directed experiences
task.learning_goal: Develop the language and literacy skills necessary for school success

context.environment: Child selected learning experiences in which children choose the direction of the experience

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When teachers focus on giving directions which require children to listen and obey rather than to use their words in response to a richer, more challenging verbal exchange
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Employed more undesired language usage when speaking to adults; demonstrated desired language usage less than half of the time

behavior_patterns.condition: When interacting with peers during non-teaching directed experiences
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Uses expressive language to convey a thought, want, or need more frequently than with adults
related_quotes: I am going to build a castle in the block center.

behavior_patterns.condition: When experiencing a disagreement to get ones way
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Uses aggressive/bullying language (threatening words used to get ones way)
related_quotes: If you don’t give me that toy, you’ll be sorry!

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Uses language to resolve conflict in either a positive or negative context
related_quotes: I want this book. You can get one off the shelf.
